He jumped straight onto a police car
He forgot the bag with all the money
questions.explanation: Jump Boost II got Nico out. Remembering his accomplice was apparently a separate skill tree: Otto was still inside.

questions.title: The commentary crackdown
questions.prompt: The Narration Act of 2018 treated what extremely normal chat behavior as grounds for a six-hour ban that doubled with each offense?
options: Sending more than one text narrating a show, movie or game
Sending a voice memo longer than thirty seconds
Reviewing a movie before everyone else had watched it
questions.explanation: One narration text was the limit outside the relevant chat or a discussion with another member. Dimitri's verdict on enforcement: 'We all would be locked up'.

receipts.text:
Narration Act of 2018 
More than one text about anything pertaining to a show, movie or video game in which u are having an experience except in its respective chat (and if it's a discussion between 2 or more members) is hereby banned for 6 hours doubling with each offense
We all would be locked up

receipts.text: We need to make an ai where it comes into ur group chat and turns you into a fire friend group like noodle
